wth.text: Volrath began as Vuel, Gerrard's adoptive brother, whose rise to evil starts when Starke convinces him that Gerrard intends to steal his birthright and poisons the ritual paint so that Vuel fails his initiation. Vuel steals Gerrard's Legacy items and disables Karn to finance an army against his tribe, which leads to his father's death.

Becoming Yawgmoth's first in command, Volrath enslaves Starke as chamberlain, and Starke bargains to deliver Sisay in exchange for his daughter Takara's life. Her capture baits Gerrard to Rath, where Gerrard must face his blood brother, kills a shapeshifted Volrath, and Karn is captured and tortured in the Stronghold until he is rescued.
Meanwhile the real Volrath, disguised as Takara, escapes with the gems to Mercadia City.

tmp.text: On Rath, Volrath rules from his stronghold as evincar and drives Greven il-Vec to hunt Gerrard, berating him for failing to capture him and ordering him to intercept the Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts. He tells Karn that he has failed Gerrard and the Legacy, and he takes some of the Sliver Queen's brood away to study them in the Furnace of Rath.

Volrath also uses the hive to guard the Legacy and attack the Weatherlight crew. In the Dream Halls Gerrard realizes Volrath is his adoptive brother Vuel, and he stabs him, only to learn later that he killed a shapeshifter scapegoat while the real Volrath stowed away on the Weatherlight in Takara's form.
Later Volrath vanishes and the Stronghold falls into chaos, but he returns, and as Crovax is crowned, Volrath resumes his true form and Crovax defeats him in a duel after Ertai interferes.

sth.text: In Volrath's Stronghold, Gerrard unmasks a dead shapeshifter who had worn Volrath's features and calls it practice, then tells Volrath he now gets to die. The Weatherlight crew journeys through the Stronghold, battling Volrath's creations to rescue imprisoned comrades, while Volrath tells Starke that he taught him much yet learned little.

Volrath's hold over those around him is plain, since Starke cries out to Takara but she obeys Volrath. In the end Crovax forces Belbe to name him evincar and defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.

exo.text: The Weatherlight crew, having rescued Sisay and pieces of the Legacy, must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath, while the Skyshroud elves and the Kor, Vec and Dal tribes assault the Stronghold. Volrath boasts that his enemies' death yields removal, reuse and research, and Takara says he stole everything there was of her, but Eladamri answers that Volrath is not the only one who can shape the world.

mmq.text: On Mercadia, Takara betrays the group, steals the Bones of Ramos and reveals she is Volrath, after he has turned the crew against each other and murdered Starke before the Kyren. Starke knew the voice was Takara's but the venom was Volrath's.

Volrath then tries to steal the Weatherlight, taking Hanna and Karn captive and forcing Hanna to repair it. Gerrard defeats him in a sword fight by attacking his weak side, and the Weatherlight rams and destroys Volrath's ship, the Recreant, so that he retreats to Rath.

nem.text: Volrath abandons his post as Evincar, sparking a brutal contest among would-be successors, and Phyrexia chooses Crovax to take his place. When Volrath returns from Mercadia to claim Greven and challenge Crovax, Ertai sabotages him, and Crovax executes Volrath and becomes undisputed Evincar.

plc.text: Starke reveals that the sidar's son is alive and called Volrath, and Sisay agrees to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy. Starke, however, betrays Sisay by opening a portal at Volrath's command, and she is dragged away.
Volrath also imprisons and experiments on Oleg, which drives him mad, and later puts a mother and child in the labyrinth, where Oleg becomes the Weaver King.
